summary: Deterministic checks pass and no unresolved substantive computational defect was found. Scope and annotation limitations remain. The predeclared improvement over original embeddings is not supported.

gt_provenance.details: All labels are raw dataset annotations aligned by source row and cell ID. PBMC obs has only CellID/batch/celltype; no verified donor identity. Stim uses six historical development donors and distinct stim cells. Annotation biological accuracy and pretraining overlap are not independently established.

score_normalization.details: Classification uses raw argmax predictions and fixed-eight-class F1. Reconstruction loss denominator is original TRAIN centered mean-square; not prediction max/min. Relation KL is explicitly self-supervised original-embedding teacher consistency.

result_existence.details: 24 warmups, 168 continuation checkpoints, 176 actual embeddings and prediction files, all 1936 VALID alpha candidates independently verified. All 84 cited numeric values passed the canonical evidence helper. TEST score reproduction max error 0.0; chosen VALID Cholesky error at most 1.0494050073361905e-11.

dead_code.details: Every claimed active pipeline metric has realized output artifacts and independent recomputation. Historical unused helper paths are not presented as new experiments.

scope.details: Six historically explored Kang donors, two PBMC batches, three seeds, and a seven-lambda fixed grid. Same-dataset SAE fitting is not cross-dataset SAE transfer. PBMC mask differs from Kang; rare-class support is weak. No universal/SAE-specific/causal or independent-cohort claim.

split_selection_and_lock.details: Source-derived metadata and every partition regenerated. Same checkpoint/batch sequence paired across lambdas; TRAIN feature scaling and fitting; VALID-only warmup and Ridge alpha selection; all 1480 selected artifacts locked before all 176 TEST files. No lambda is selected by TEST.

aggregation_and_figures.details: Group, seed, fixed-eight-class/support, paired contrasts, leave-one-group-out sensitivity, descriptive intervals, final KL/MSE, and plotted curve/gradient tables reproduced. Four PNGs inspected; all fixed grid points and held-out groups shown.

resolved_documentation_items: Stale inherited backbone text clarified in additive protocol note: new frozen stim inference, no scGPT optimization.
SPLITS/upstream protocol missing from original runtime binding mitigated by independent pre-TEST snapshots, exact partition regeneration, unchanged hashes, and per-fit input hashes.
